caption: The drawing shows a grid-like arrangement of twenty rectangular and square swatches, each displaying a unique textile pattern on a predominantly red background. The patterns are geometric, floral, paisley, or abstract, rendered in various colors such as yellow, green, blue, black, and white. Some swatches have diagonal stripes or crisscrossing lines, others feature repeated floral or leaf motifs, and a few include small dot decorations. At the bottom center, there is a square motif outlined in grey and white with a red ribbon-like design forming a circle with a bow at the top and bottom. Each textile sample is set apart from the others with ample cream-colored background space between them, and small black Arabic numerals are present below each swatch for identification. The entire arrangement is framed within a larger pale background with a thin border.
title: Printed Quilted Patches
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
